node.statement: Self-contained second inequality: set B_i=max(-a_s(i),0)+max(-a_t(i),0)-1+a_r(i) and R_i=R_{r,j}(i). Since r != s and t is the remaining chart index, the indices q != r are exactly s and t, so the root definition of E_r gives E_r(i)=max(B_i,0). The scalar inequality max(X+Y,0) <= max(X,0)+max(Y,0), applied with X=B_i and Y=R_i, gives max(B_i+R_i,0) <= max(B_i,0)+max(R_i,0)=E_r(i)+max(R_{r,j}(i),0).
